# Finding Balance Counseling

> Texas practice led by Reem Glasco, LPC-S (licence 66562), based in Cedar Park and working online statewide. The practice is primarily for therapists: LPC Associates seeking supervision, therapists seeking EMDRIA-approved EMDR consultation, and clinicians attending retreats or training. Reem also holds a small therapy caseload for developmental trauma, C-PTSD, anxiety and depression, with the practice's LPC Associates seeing additional clients at lower fees.

Key facts, current as of 2026-09-12:

- LPC Supervisor in Texas since 2009; over 15 years of clinical experience.
- LPC supervision is $425 a month and includes three individual hours and one group hour, online, statewide in Texas.
- Supervision openings: one in fall 2026 and one in spring 2027. Agency contracts of three months are $500 a month.
- EMDRIA Approved Consultant. Individual EMDR consultation is $185, online.
- Individual therapy is $240 for a 50-minute online session, private pay. Not accepting new BCBS clients.
- Trail walk and movement therapy is $240 to $370 per session, in person in Texas, adults only.
- Modalities: IFS-informed EMDR (the clinical focus), Somatic Experiencing (SEP), NARM, EMDR certified with ASSYST, PRECI and IGTP-OTS, Brainspotting, BASE-P.
- Optional equine-assisted supervision and mindfulness retreats near Dripping Springs, Texas; equine supervision sessions are $60 each.
- Annual mindful trail retreat for interns, associates and licensed therapists, plus periodic ethics CEUs for Texas LPCs.
- The site publishes a free Texas LPC licensure guide: 3,000 supervised hours, 1,500 direct, an 18-month minimum, four supervision hours a month, no more than 50% group, and a 60-month expiry on the LPC Associate licence (22 TAC 681.92).

  - [EMDR Consultation](https://findingbalances.com/for-therapists/emdr-consultation): EMDR consultation toward certification with Reem Glasco, LPC-S, an EMDRIA Approved Consultant. Individual online consults are $185, IFS-informed.
  - [Retreats & Training](https://findingbalances.com/for-therapists/retreats-training): Mindful trail retreats, equine-assisted training and ethics CEUs for Texas therapists, interns and LPC Associates, led by Reem Glasco, LPC-S, near Austin.

- [Fees](https://findingbalances.com/fees): Therapy is $240 per 50-minute online session, LPC supervision $425 a month, EMDR consultation $185. Cancellation policy, insurance status and Texas licensing notices.

- [Therapy](https://findingbalances.com/therapy): Therapy in Texas for developmental trauma, C-PTSD, anxiety and depression with Reem Glasco, LPC-S, or with the practice's associates at lower fees.
